connector.name: Druid MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: AI-powered MCP server for Apache Druid cluster management and analytic
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image druid-mcp-server:2.0.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.iunera. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
